topic: Prioritizing analytics and traffic over campaign setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the technical requirements for adding detailed inventory data, specifically moving beyond just facility level to include frame parameters and associated metrics. It was decided that for immediate rollout, campaign manager features related to RZK (presumably a specific metric or system) should be deprioritized. The focus will shift to launching transit analytics and traffic reporting first, rather than fully implementing the frame-level inventory setup.

Technical work included deploying new beta versions with social classes and combined campaigns. A decision was made regarding version control for the beta deployment.
decisions: Deprioritize Campaign Manager features related to RZK initially.
Focus immediate rollout on transit analytics and traffic reporting instead of full frame-level inventory setup.
action_items: Someone needs to write up the plan for the deprioritized campaign manager features (RZK).
Deploy new beta version with social classes and combined campaigns.
